data.title: Riverside Views
data.about:
DAMAC Riverside Views, an upcoming apartment project by DAMAC Properties, is part of the DAMAC Riverside community. Offering a unique riverside living, this development features 1 and 2-bedroom apartments providing residents with breathtaking water views. With seamless connectivity to major highways, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, residents enjoy unmatched convenience and accessibility.

Living in DAMAC Riverside Views promises a lifestyle of comfort and luxury. The project boasts a range of onsite dining outlets, providing culinary delights just steps from your home. Thoughtfully curated DAMAC Riverside Views amenities elevate daily living, making this an exceptional choice for those seeking modern residences in an ideal setting.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Stunning Water Views at DAMAC Riverside Views
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: DAMAC Riverside Views is strategically located offering seamless connectivity.
  • Diverse Property Options: Offers 1- and 2-bedroom ultra-luxury apartments.
  • Unmatched Amenities: DAMAC Riverside Views features hydroponic farms, Zen spas, and floating cinemas for ultimate luxury and wellness.
  • Accessibility: Just minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai for unmatched convenience.
  • Wellness-Focused Living: Designed with cutting-edge fitness facilities and essential oil lakes for a holistic lifestyle.
  • Social & Cultural Hub: Includes a clubhouse, amphitheater, and floating opera for enriching community experiences.
  • Easy Payment Plan: Experience hassle-free ownership with DAMAC Riverside Views’ 35-month flexible payment plan.
    Family-Friendly Features: Adventure land for kids and peaceful recreational spaces make it ideal for families.

location_tile.title: Effortless Connectivity for a Modern Lifestyle at DAMAC Riverside
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
DAMAC Riverside enjoys a strategic location at the crossroads of Yalayis Street and Emirates Road, offering residents unparalleled connectivity to key destinations across Dubai. Conveniently situated just minutes away from Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai, the community ensures easy accessibility for both professionals and families. Divided into two unique sub-districts, Green Vein and Water Vein, DAMAC Riverside features a blend of modern apartments and spacious townhouses, catering to diverse lifestyle preferences

  • 9 minutes to Expo City Dubai
  • 12 minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 15 minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 16 minutes to Mall of the Emirates
